description: The two data-stream type bytes. Unlike the other fixtures these are bitfields, not registries: a type is valid when its bits satisfy the rules below, so `valid` is the exhaustive set and a stack must reject every byte outside it.

subgroup_header.description: Type byte of a subgroup stream header.

bits.name: PROPERTIES
bits.meaning: Properties present in every object on the stream

bits.name: SUBGROUP_ID_MODE
bits.meaning: How the Subgroup ID is determined; see subgroup_id_modes

bits.name: END_OF_GROUP
bits.meaning: This subgroup carries the final object in the group

bits.name: REQUIRED
bits.meaning: Always set; a type with it clear is not a subgroup header

bits.name: DEFAULT_PRIORITY
bits.meaning: Publisher Priority omitted from the header, taken from the subscription

bits.name: FIRST_OBJECT
bits.meaning: First object on the stream is the first published in the subgroup

subgroup_id_modes.name: FIRST_OBJECT_ID
subgroup_id_modes.meaning: Subgroup ID is the ID of the first object on the stream

subgroup_id_modes.name: EXPLICIT
subgroup_id_modes.meaning: Subgroup ID is carried as a field in the header

subgroup_id_modes.name: RESERVED
subgroup_id_modes.meaning: Reserved; a header using it must be rejected

object_datagram.description: Type byte of an object datagram.

bits.name: DEFAULT_PRIORITY
bits.meaning: Publisher Priority omitted, taken from the subscription

bits.name: STATUS
bits.meaning: Carries an object status, not a payload

rules: STATUS (0x20) and END_OF_GROUP (0x02) must not both be set
